name: sorin_vampire_lord_minus8_ability_targets_one_creature
notes: G3 (target->all at 1/2/effect/args/ability/effect/args/target). Printed: '[-8]: Until end of turn, each Vampire you control gains "{T}: Gain control of target creature."' The granted ability targets one creature. Sorin at 9 loyalty uses -8 (1 left). Vamp One's ability aimed at P1's artifact (not a creature) is refused as it is announced, before anything is paid; aimed at P1's Giant it resolves: P0 controls the Giant, P1 keeps its Bear and its artifact, and Vamp One is tapped.
